info.title: Skills Gateway
info.description:
Enterprise gateway for git-distributed AI agent skill marketplaces (Claude Code plugins, Copilot, Cursor).

## Model

Upstream marketplaces are ingested into quarantine as immutable, SHA-identified snapshots, held until a reviewer approves them, and served to unmodified git clients over smart-HTTP. Only approved content is ever fetchable; upstream changes never alter served content until re-ingested and re-approved (rug-pull protection). Every git fetch and every administrative action lands in an append-only audit ledger.

## Quick start

1. `POST /api/marketplaces` — register an upstream by clone URL (http/https only; the gateway pins ingestion to the upstream default branch — a `ref` cannot be supplied).
2. `POST /api/marketplaces/{name}/ingest` — fetch the upstream into quarantine; the snapshot is `held` (or `rejected` on policy violation, e.g. non-local plugin sources).
3. `GET /api/snapshots/{id}/content` — inspect the plugins and skills the snapshot ships before deciding.
4. `POST /api/snapshots/{id}/approve` — publish it to the facade.
5. `POST /api/tokens` — issue a personal access token, then `git clone http://token:<PAT>@<gateway>/git/{marketplace}`.

## Authentication

Browser sessions authenticate via OIDC (the app is its own BFF — tokens never reach the browser); git clients authenticate with personal access tokens over the standard credential-helper flow (Basic auth, username `token`). Tokens are stored as hashes and shown exactly once at creation.

This API is the same surface the admin portal uses. The gateway also exposes its own CycloneDX SBOM at `/actuator/sbom` and health at `/actuator/health`.

tags.name: Marketplaces
tags.description: Register upstream marketplaces and ingest them into held, SHA-pinned snapshots. Registration enforces the URL scheme allowlist and the gateway-pinned ref.

tags.name: Snapshots
tags.description: The approval gate: approve or reject held snapshots, inspect their plugin/skill inventory, and retrieve provenance (what was served, from where, who approved).

tags.name: Audit
tags.description: Append-only ledger of every git facade fetch and every administrative action, each attributed to an identity.

tags.name: Tokens
tags.description: Personal access tokens for git clients: hashed at rest, cleartext shown exactly once, revocable at any time.

tags.name: Session
tags.description: Identity of the authenticated browser session.

put.summary: Set an audit export sink's ledger position
put.description: Replay: setting the position back re-delivers every ledger entry after it on the next export pass. Receivers de-duplicate on the ledger sequence carried by each entry.

get.description: Every registered receiver with its event filter. Signing secrets are never returned.

post.description: Registers a receiver for snapshot lifecycle events. The signing secret is returned exactly once, in this response, and is never readable afterwards.

201.description: Subscriber registered; response carries the show-once secret

400.description: Disallowed URL scheme, or an unknown event name

409.description: A subscriber with that name already exists

post.description: Clears the deletion marks, provided compaction has not yet removed the snapshot.
Marks the snapshot rejected with the reviewer identity and timestamp; its content is never served.

409.description: Snapshot is not in the held state

post.description: Publishes the snapshot to the git facade and records the reviewer identity and timestamp. Only held snapshots can be approved. A snapshot whose latest vetting chain run did not clear — including one that has no chain run at all — is refused unless the request carries an override reason, which is recorded against the run and in the audit ledger.

409.description: Snapshot is not in the held state, or its vetting chain blocked and no reason was given

post.description: Soft-deletes every snapshot the policies select. Equivalent to what the scheduled pass does when retention is enabled.
Permanently removes every soft-deleted snapshot whose restore window has elapsed, together with its pinned commit in the quarantine repository.

get.description: All registered marketplaces with every snapshot and its state (held, approved, or rejected).

post.description: Registers an upstream git skill marketplace by clone URL. The URL scheme must be on the configured allowlist (default http/https). The ingested ref is set by the gateway (the upstream default branch) and cannot be overridden; a request supplying any other ref is rejected.

400.description: Disallowed URL scheme, or a ref other than the default branch

409.description: A marketplace with that name already exists

post.description: Fetches the marketplace's upstream default branch into quarantine and records an immutable snapshot pinned to the upstream commit SHA. The snapshot is held until a reviewer approves it; manifests declaring non-local plugin sources are rejected.

201.description: Snapshot recorded (held, or rejected on policy violation)

get.description: Every registered sink with its target, its position in the ledger, and how many entries it still has to receive. Signing secrets are never returned.

post.description: Registers a push consumer of the ledger. Batches are POSTed to the target URL by the same signed, retried delivery machinery as lifecycle webhooks; the signing secret is returned exactly once, in this response.

201.description: Sink registered; response carries the show-once secret

409.description: A sink or webhook subscriber with that name already exists

get.description: Most recent deliveries first, with state, attempt count, and the last response status or error — the operator's view of a failing integration.

The snapshot's latest vetting chain run: each connector's verdict in chain order, the findings behind it, and the fail-closed aggregate that gates approval. A snapshot the chain has never run against reports a blocked outcome and no run.

200.description: The latest chain run and the configured chain

get.description: What was served, from where, and who approved it: upstream URL, upstream commit SHA, state, reviewer, and timestamps.
The plugins declared by the snapshot's marketplace manifest and the skills found under each plugin's source tree — the basis for future per-plugin/per-skill limiting.

200.description: Plugins and skills in the snapshot

get.description: The snapshots the policies in force would delete right now, each with the criterion that selected it. A dry run: nothing is written.
Username of the authenticated browser session.

Append-only record of every git facade fetch: client source address, authenticated identity, repository, ref, commit SHA, and timestamp. Portal actions are not in this ledger; approvals live in snapshot provenance.

get.summary: Stream the audit ledger as NDJSON
get.description: Newline-delimited JSON, one ledger entry per line in ascending ledger sequence, for ingestion by an external SIEM. Poll incrementally by passing the sequence from the X-Skills-Gateway-Audit-Cursor response header back as 'after'; an empty body means the consumer is caught up. Entries younger than the commit-settling lag are withheld so a cursor can never step over an in-flight append.

200.description: The entries after the cursor, newline-delimited

delete.description: Removes the subscriber and its delivery history; no further events are queued for it.
Marks the snapshot deleted and restorable until the end of the marketplace's restore window; its vetting state is unchanged. Approved snapshots are served by the git facade and can never be deleted.

409.description: Snapshot is approved, or already deleted

delete.description: Removes the sink and its delivery channel; no further batches are queued for it.

after.description: Ledger sequence to resume after; entries following it are delivered again

cursorPosition.description: Ledger sequence last handed to this sink

ledgerHead.description: Highest ledger sequence written so far

behind.description: Ledger entries not yet handed to this sink

enabled.description: Whether export passes run for this sink

url.description: Target URL; scheme must be on the configured allowlist (default http/https)

events.description: Comma-delimited event filter, or * for every event

CreatedSubscriber.description: A freshly created subscriber; the only time the signing secret is ever returned

events.description: Comma-delimited event filter, or * for all

IssuedToken.description: A freshly issued token; the only time the cleartext is ever returned

token.description: Cleartext token value - shown exactly once, only a hash is stored

Snapshot.description: An immutable, SHA-identified snapshot of an upstream marketplace

sha.description: Upstream commit SHA the snapshot is pinned to

violation.description: Policy violation that rejected the snapshot, or null

decidedBy.description: Reviewer who decided, or null while held

decidedAt.description: Decision time, or null while held

deletedAt.description: When the snapshot was soft-deleted, or null when it is live

deletedReason.description: Retention criterion or administrative reason for the deletion

purgeAfter.description: End of the restore window; after it compaction removes the snapshot permanently

ApproveRequest.description: Approval request; the reason is required only for a snapshot the vetting chain blocked

overrideReason.description: Why the reviewer is approving a snapshot whose vetting chain blocked. Recorded against the chain run and in the audit ledger (GW_0041).
overrideReason.example: false positive: the key in fixtures/ is a documented dummy value

acted.description: Snapshots acted on by this pass

name.description: Gateway-local marketplace name; becomes the facade clone path /git/{name}

url.description: Upstream clone URL; scheme must be on the configured allowlist (default http/https)

ref.description: Must be omitted or equal the upstream default branch; the ingested ref is the gateway's decision, never the consumer's (GW_0017)

forge.description: Detected forge (github, gitlab, bitbucket, azure-devops, gitea) or null

upstreamUpdatedAt.description: Last upstream update as reported by the forge

url.description: Target URL batches are POSTed to; scheme must be on the configured allowlist (default http/https)

after.description: Ledger sequence to start after; omit to start at the beginning

CreatedSink.description: A newly registered audit export sink, with its show-once signing secret

url.description: Target URL batches are POSTed to

cursorPosition.description: Ledger sequence the sink starts after

secret.description: Signing secret of the sink's delivery channel - shown exactly once

SubscriberView.description: A webhook subscriber without its signing secret

enabled.description: Whether deliveries are queued for this subscriber

WebhookDelivery.description: One webhook delivery: an event queued for a subscriber, with its attempt history

id.description: Delivery id; sent as the de-duplication header

payload.description: Serialized JSON body; the exact bytes that are signed and sent

nextAttemptAt.description: When the next attempt becomes due

lastStatus.description: HTTP status of the last attempt, or null

lastError.description: Error of the last attempt, or null

TokenView.description: A token without its secret; the cleartext is only returned at creation

revokedAt.description: Revocation time, or null while active

ConnectorView.description: A connector configured in the vetting chain

description.description: What the connector looks for, and what it cannot see

Finding.description: One thing a vetting connector found in a snapshot

location.description: Where in the snapshot it was found, normally path:line

message.description: Reviewer-facing explanation; never echoes the matched secret

Run.description: One execution of the vetting chain against a snapshot

outcome.description: Fail-closed aggregate of the run's verdicts

finishedAt.description: When the run finished, or null if it never did

overrideBy.description: Reviewer who approved despite a blocked outcome, or null

overrideAt.description: When the override was recorded, or null

overrideReason.description: Reason the reviewer gave for the override, or null

verdicts.description: The run's verdicts, in chain order

VerdictView.description: One connector's recorded verdict within a chain run

position.description: Position of the connector in the chain

detail.description: One-line summary of the findings, or null when there are none

reportUrl.description: External report URL, when the connector produced one

VettingView.description: A snapshot's latest vetting chain run, and the chain that produced it

outcome.description: Fail-closed aggregate of the run; a snapshot with no run is blocked

run.description: The latest run with its verdicts and findings, or null if the chain never ran

connectors.description: The connectors configured in the chain, in the order they run

Provenance.description: Provenance of a snapshot: what was served, from where, and who approved it

PluginContent.description: A plugin declared by the marketplace manifest

source.description: Relative source path inside the marketplace repository

SkillInfo.description: A skill found under a plugin's source tree

path.description: Path of the SKILL.md within the snapshot

SnapshotContent.description: What a snapshot ships: the manifest's plugins and their skills

Candidate.description: A snapshot a retention policy would delete, and the criterion that selected it

sha.description: Upstream commit SHA the snapshot is pinned to

state.description: Vetting state; never approved, which is categorically ineligible

MarketplaceView.description: A registered marketplace with its snapshots and forge metadata

name.description: Gateway-local name (also the facade clone path)

forge.description: Detected forge (github, gitlab, bitbucket, azure-devops, gitea) or null

forgeProject.description: Project path on the forge, e.g. acme/skills
